subject: Civil Engineering Draftsperson (SEEK 95378071), Marc Masarate

letter.company_line: All Seasons Communications has built and maintained fibre optic and telecommunications networks since 2016, including pit and pipe installation, trenching and network design and construction.
letter.subject: Civil Engineering Draftsperson, Perth (SEEK 95378071)
paragraphs: I saw your Civil Engineering Draftsperson advert on SEEK. You ask for a Diploma or Advanced Diploma in civil engineering or engineering drafting, and I finished my Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, so I am applying.

At Albright Institute I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints, which ties in with the pit and pipe and trenching work your team builds. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed drawings against project requirements, flagged issues that needed clarification, wrote site reports and kept progress and material records, much like the checking and drawing register work in your advert.

My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid drafting job, so I would start at junior level and learn your standards and as-built process. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth. I have a White Card, a driver's licence and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about the role.

screening_answers.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
screening_answers.answer: I have a temporary visa with full working rights (Subclass 485, valid to December 2027).

screening_answers.question: How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
screening_answers.answer: No paid civil drafting experience; drafting in AutoCAD and Civil 3D was Advanced Diploma coursework. Pick the lowest band SEEK offers.

screening_answers.question: How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
screening_answers.answer: MARC TO ANSWER (no notice period on record).

checklist: Confirm with Marc that he is willing to discuss relocating to Perth before applying
Check Gmail again for any All Seasons Communications or ascoms.com.au receipt, then open https://www.seek.com.au/job/95378071 and confirm it is still open
Apply on SEEK with the master resume and the saved cover letter PDF
Answer the screening questions as listed; Marc answers notice period, and do not claim paid drafting experience
Note the SEEK receipt date in /workspace/job-finds (tracker recording is paused)
notes: Direct employer advert on SEEK (ABN 81 611 866 472). Perth role; relocation to be confirmed by Marc.
